criteria.statement: Mixed old/new worker behavior is documented and tested: old workers without telemetry remain eligible with reduced capacity; new workers with fresh full telemetry remain open.
Partial collector scenarios degrade cleanly: unavailable memory becomes unknown/reduced, unavailable disk/GPU/thermal signals are omitted, and all-missing telemetry is reduced.
Stale telemetry older than ten minutes is treated as degraded.
Worker advertisement stale-write guard preserves newer telemetry and pressure under relay reordering while accepting same-timestamp replacement.
End-to-end disk-pressure lifecycle blocks standard admission, allows cleanup admission, then unblocks standard admission after pressure resolves.
Worker pressure monitor reports capacity transitions for degradation and recovery without reporting unchanged warning states.
